title: Leading the Three Deuces band with Zutty
summary: Roy took a leader job at the Three Deuces with Zutty's group, added Joe, and the broadcast wire made the club a hangout.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Because they'd been trying to get... Me and Chu used to go the Three Deuces and jam. The only reason we went down there is because we used to get good ribs there. And it was nice playing. Art was working there. Zutty had a group down there, and I think Vernell York(?) was working with him.

It's funny how I hit on that name. I haven't mentioned that name in ages! But they offered me the job at the same salary I was getting with Fletcher, and I'd be the leader, you know. So I think Zutty got Scoops and Dave Young and Chuck and Teddy...
Teddy Cole. And it really... The gig turned out nice, you know. We used to have a ball down there playing.
Your brother was not in the band originally?
We added him later, yeah. Added him later, then he started writing some charts for the band. Which made it a little (?).
And you had a broadcast wire in there.

Well, we were on the air late, and during those years most of the big bands traveled, they had a radio in the bus. And everybody used to catch us. And my wife used to make the programs out there, and she had everything (?), man. Everything was stretched out, you know. When the guys would get in town, into Chicago, that's the first place they'd come to, the Three Deuces. That's the place that all the people would hang out.
